name: How much does window frame repair typically cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does window frame repair typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window frame repair in the Bay Area varies significantly based on the material of the frame (wood, vinyl, aluminum), the extent of the damage, and the labor involved. Minor repairs might range from a few hundred dollars, while more extensive restoration work could be higher. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after a thorough inspection of your specific window frames to ensure accuracy and address your unique needs.
